Direct upstream parent/fix and an unchanged partial fixed-tree fixture: only tests/test_chinese.py::test_chinese plus original tests/__init__.py,tests/utils.py,LICENSE. Not a full upstream test suite.
Locale profiles share identical source/fixture/fault and dependence group; two profiles or repeated trials are not independent faults/observations.
Explicit interventions replace unpinned original bootstrap with CPython3.8.1 nativearm64,pytest8.3.5 and reviewed wheels; no setup.py, source/header/test patches, monkeypatches or mocks.
PYTHONUTF8=0 and PYTHONCOERCECLOCALE=0 preserve the declared locale; PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 affects streams only. PYTHONHASHSEED=0 is not an independent observation.

PythonToolbox includes MIT,Apache2,BSD2,wxPython and inferred CPython-derived components; preserve whole wheels and component notices. Its unused headerless mapping-test attribution is inferred, not verified origin.
Old CPython image and bundled pip20.0.2,setuptools45.1.0,wheel0.34.2 are benchmark conditions; SDK dependency audits do not establish security of that historical image.
Non-assertion exceptions remain test_error; error-to-pass pairs are inconclusive under the existing strict generic classifier, even when compatible with the curated fix.
No real historical CI builds, scheduling costs, fault prevalence, calibration, performance benefit, statistical admission or generalization are inferred from capture times.
Source/provider availability and component terms are independently recorded; raw source, wheels and outcome packets remain outside Git and are not distributed in COLEMAN packages.
